200.description: Signal received and queued (or a repeat of one already received)

message.example: Webhook received and queued for processing

replay.description: Present and true when this request repeats one received in the last 60 seconds; it runs once.

400.description: The body could not be read — invalid JSON, a missing required field, or a natural-language message that could not be parsed. A parse failure adds error, extractedFields, missingFields and confidence.

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.

401.description: Refused by the slot's verification mode — a missing, wrong, expired or replayed signature, or a source address that is not allowed. Always "This webhook request was not accepted."

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.

403.description: Automation is not allowed on this slot (code AUTOMATION_NOT_ALLOWED, with a reason) — typically an exchange slot with no active plan — or the provider is not active.

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.

404.description: No slot has this webhook secret ("Account not found. Please connect it first.")

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.

429.description: Rate limit reached — 300 requests a minute per source IP, 120 per slot. Carries a Retry-After header and a retryAfter field.

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.
Account not found. Please connect it first.

503.description: The webhook is temporarily unavailable. Carries a Retry-After header.

message.example: Account not found. Please connect it first.
